topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: The streets were slick with rain, the kind of night that makes you stand a little closer to the building, like there’s a ghost in the mist. I got the call from my best friend, the one I’d known since we were kids playing in the gutters. He’s moving across the country, said it’s for a new job, a fresh start. But I know him, and I know when there’s more to the story than the tough break he’s selling. I played it cool, told him to keep in touch. But the rain kept falling, and the city stretched out cold and far. I knew this was one of those goodbyes that leaves a taste in your mouth, like old whiskey, bitter and strong. I didn’t ask why, not yet. Some things you have to pull out slow, peel back the layers, until the truth is all that’s left.
